Item 2. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
The following discussion should be read together with our condensed consolidated financial statements.
Overview
Revenue increased 22% to $165.0 million in the second quarter of 2026, driven by higher volumes in the Americas and the absence of the customer destocking that affected the first half of 2025. We expect the order backlog of $410 million to support growth in the second half of the year.
Results of Operations
(in millions)Q2 2026Q2 2025Change
Revenue165.0135.022%
Gross profit66.054.022%
Gross margin was flat at 40.0% as price increases offset freight inflation. Operating expenses rose 8% mainly due to engineering headcount added for the new controller platform.
Liquidity and Capital Resources
Cash and cash equivalents were $150.0 million at June 30, 2026. We repaid $10.0 million of term debt during the quarter and drew $20.0 million under our revolving credit facility to fund working capital.
Capital expenditures were $25.0 million in the first half of 2026, primarily for the Ohio plant expansion.
